== Dan͟ggu Geikie Gorge ==

Dan͟ggu Geikie Gorge (18.0733°S 125.7212°E﻿ / -18.0733; 125.7212), formerly Geikie Gorge, is a feature of the Napier Range located within the National Park, 20 kilometres (12 mi) from Fitzroy Crossing. It is believed to be one of the best-known and most easily accessed gorges in the region.
Along with Tunnel Creek and Windjana Gorge, Geikie Gorge is part of an ancient barrier reef that developed during the Devonian Period. The walls of the gorge are 30 m (98 ft) high. The 8-kilometre (5.0 mi) gorge was created by the flowing waters of the Fitzroy River, which still flows through the region. Freshwater crocodiles, Leichhardt's sawfish and coach-whip stingrays inhabit the river.
